prompt:
Architectural floor plan of one room, drawn straight from above as a clean top-down orthographic plan view in the style of a set designer's ground plan: white background, thick dark walls with gaps for doors and windows, door swings drawn as arcs, windows as thin double lines, and every piece of furniture as a simple outline from above, to scale. In the plan, its bottom edge is the front wall, its top edge the back wall, its left edge the left wall and its right edge the right wall, as the establishing view names them. Draw only the doors, windows and openings the description names. Location: INT. JI RAN'S OFFICE. A sleek, modern, contemporary corner office of a high-end architecture and design firm on a high floor, in warm walnut, black leather and white marble. Back wall: floor-to-ceiling glass windows over a daytime city skyline, the main light source, throwing soft daylight from behind towards the camera. A big walnut executive desk stands centred in front of these windows, facing the camera, with a high-backed black leather chair with padded arms behind it. The desktop holds rolled and spread architectural plans, a fan of wood samples, a small brushed-metal abstract figurine and a pour-over coffee station. Left wall: tall walnut shelving with architectural models and material samples, and at its centre a framed black-and-white typographic sign reading "JUST DO IT." In front of the left wall stands the seating area: a tan leather sofa against the shelving, two tan leather armchairs facing each other, and a low white marble coffee table between them. Right wall: a tall walnut door near the front corner, the way in, and a slim console with a plant next to it. Front wall, behind the camera: a pin-up wall of drawings. The open floor between the desk and the right-wall door is a clear space of pale oak flooring. Additional light comes from warm recessed ceiling spots and a black task lamp on the desk.

Avoid: people, text, labels, numbers, letters, dimensions, compass, logos, watermark, a door or window the description does not name.
